activity.notes: Talleyrand returned as Minister of Foreign Relations on 22 November 1799 under the Consulate. ATLAS closes the republican segment at the constitutional proclamation of the First French Empire on 18 May 1804; his ministerial service continued without a personal-office interruption into the imperial segment.
